clips.title: 美债收益率4.75%：算高吗？，对比2005年5%

subtitles.en: There's a couple of things happening in the global bond markets and hell.
subtitles.zh: 全球债券市场正在发生一些变化。

subtitles.en: What happens next? Good morning, Francine. What happens next?
subtitles.zh: 接下来会怎样？早上好，Francine。接下来会怎样？

subtitles.en: We are in the middle of an investment boom, and boom markets are reflecting that.
subtitles.zh: 我们正处于**热潮之中，市场也反映了这一点。

subtitles.en: It's a strong economy, everybody's issuing, everybody's trying to win the race, in the energy, national security, in technology.
subtitles.zh: 经济强劲，各方都在发行，在能源、国家安全和技术领域竞相争先。

subtitles.en: And boom markets are reflecting that competition for funds, rates are higher, but they are high for the right reason.
subtitles.zh: 市场反映了对资金的竞争，利率较高，但高得合理。

subtitles.en: I mean, there are concerns about the credibility of the Fed chair that was largely laid to rest after the Jackson Hall's speech.
subtitles.zh: 对美联储主席可信度的担忧，在杰克逊霍尔演讲后基本消散。

subtitles.en: Do you have concerns about these teething problems? What happens when you become Fed chair?
subtitles.zh: 您对这些磨合问题有担忧吗？当您成为美联储主席时会怎样？

subtitles.en: Like, what kind of communication do you need? When there is a new boss in town, you always change a little bit, people need to learn how you do it.
subtitles.zh: 比如，您需要什么样的沟通？新领导上任，总会有些变化，人们需要适应。

subtitles.en: I think he did a good job of Jackson Hall. He explains his view, now he needs to deliver.
subtitles.zh: 我认为他在杰克逊霍尔表现不错，他阐述了自己的观点，现在需要付诸行动。

subtitles.en: We'll see. We'll judge him on his actions, not on his words. What do you think he'll deliver?
subtitles.zh: 我们拭目以待，我们会看他的行动，而非言辞。您认为他会采取什么行动？

subtitles.en: He'll probably go into tight and bright a little bit. I mean, the economy is doing well, inflation is high, it's not clear that financial conditions are restrictive.
subtitles.zh: 他可能会稍微收紧政策。经济表现良好，通胀较高，但金融条件是否紧缩尚不明朗。

subtitles.en: So taking a little bit of insurance against inflation is probably the right thing to do.
subtitles.zh: 因此，采取一些通胀保险措施可能是正确的做法。

subtitles.en: What happens to treasuries? Treasuries will probably stabilize.
subtitles.zh: 国债收益率可能会趋于稳定。

subtitles.en: I think they are reflecting... I was looking at the Bloomberg chart a couple of minutes ago.
subtitles.zh: 我认为它们反映了……几分钟前我看了彭博图表。

subtitles.en: You know, rates in 2005 were around 5% on the 10-year point.
We are 475. It's a similar environment. It's not that high.
subtitles.zh: 现在是4.75%，环境相似，并不算高。

subtitles.en: When you look at inflation across the world, I mean, do you see pockets when you look at bonds across the world?
subtitles.zh: 当你观察全球通胀时，在全球债券市场中是否看到一些机会？

subtitles.en: Where do you see the biggest value? So, rates are starting now to price what I think is a higher neutral rate.
subtitles.zh: 最大的价值在哪里？利率开始反映更高的中性利率。
